title: Custom frames.
lead: A personal consultation, a careful selection of materials, a frame made around your artwork — never the other way around.
body:
For your home.
Custom frames and mirrors designed to sit naturally in your space and bring out the character of what they contain.

For artists and businesses.
Tailored framing solutions for galleries, studios, hospitality spaces, offices and creative projects.

Made with care.
We work with different woods, colours, profiles and finishes. Every choice is made together, around the work and its context.
